en-US.description: A rich software development environment for business rules-based software and applications.
en-US.longDescription: Invantive Studio is a rich software development environment that gives engineers and analysts the ability to design and develop high quality business rules-based software and applications. Our model driven software development environment empowers you to define and analyze the terms of rules that assist in the engineering of your business software and applications. Invantive Studio enables you to automate and coordinate all your activities associated with software engineering. You will be able to automate software engineering processes such as: design, development, testing, analysis, implementation and maintenance. In addition you will be empowered to model your software development processes via backward and forward reasoning over the rules base. With Invantive Studio you will be able to define the steps, methodologies, requirements and specifications of your software and applications with ease.
en-US.name: Invantive Studio

zh-CN.description: 功能丰富的软件开发环境，适用于基于业务规则的软件和应用程序。
zh-CN.longDescription: Invantive Studio 是一款功能丰富的软件开发环境，为工程师和分析师提供了设计与开发高质量业务规则驱动型软件和应用程序的能力。我们基于模型的软件开发环境使您能够定义和分析有助于业务软件及应用程序工程化的规则条款。通过 Invantive Studio，您可以自动化并协调所有与软件工程相关的活动，实现包括设计、开发、测试、分析、实施和维护在内的全流程自动化。此外，您还能基于规则库进行正向与逆向推理，对软件开发流程进行建模。借助 Invantive Studio，您将能够轻松定义软件及应用程序的步骤、方法、需求与规范。
